mcqs.q: Which event triggered Bazalgette's sewer system?
options: Cholera epidemic 1854
Great Stink 1858
Great Fire 1666
Typhoid outbreak 1860

mcqs.q: Why did Britain win the Battle of Britain?
options: The RAF won because Spitfires were better than any German aircraft.
Radar, the Dowding command system, home advantage in pilot recovery, German tactical errors (switching to bombing cities), and adequate fighter production.
Hitler called off the attack to invade the USSR immediately.
Because Britain had no army at all in the 1930s.

mcqs.q: Why did Britain pursue appeasement in the 1930s?
options: Because Britain had no army at all in the 1930s.
Because Chamberlain was a coward and admired Hitler.
The Schlieffen Plan failed because it tried to invade Russia first.
Britain was militarily unprepared, traumatised by WWI losses, sympathetic to revising Versailles, and feared communism more than Nazism.
